title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1972-08-25
lineage: 7in Betty Board Reel > PCM501ES analog out > Fostex D5 optical S/PDIF out > disk

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a marathon four‑hour set that fans hail as one of the best‑played and best‑sung Dead shows.
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes this partial recording as an excellent‑sounding soundboard remaster, noting only a slightly hot vocal mix. The concert itself was a super‑long, high‑energy performance—about four hours straight—that is remembered as one of the most well‑played and well‑sung shows in Dead history.

ai_rating.rationale: A single, enthusiastic 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and recording quality; weighting favors the show (70%) resulting in a high overall rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced soundboard capture with a slightly hot vocal mix; remaster considered as good as other versions.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon four‑hour set that flowed continuously despite the lack of a documented complete setlist.
